guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Design requires rustdoc on every public type and method; verified after implementation.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep the standalone WR-006 Domain source independent of Weekly Radar shared modules and other feature implementations.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: src/features/weekly_radar/domain/rising_dropped.rs uses standard-library types only, and .ai/evidence/reference-impact/wi-wr-006-rising-dropped.json records no shared-module or cross-feature impact.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat previous/current states and StructuralEvidenceDelta as supplied upstream facts; do not infer or recalculate Stage, Ranking, Top5, Distance, or score.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: src/features/weekly_radar/domain/rising_dropped.rs routes explicit StructuralEvidenceDelta kinds and retains opaque previous/current Stage values; tests/weekly_radar_rising_dropped.rs verifies non-structural inputs emit no event.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve evidence identity and insertion order; reject duplicate or overlapping evidence identities deterministically.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: EvidenceSet preserves insertion order and rejects duplicate IDs, while EvidenceDeltaDetails rejects overlap; focused tests cover both failures in tests/weekly_radar_rising_dropped.rs.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Reject same-period event identity and company conflicts deterministically; do not silently merge or overwrite.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: WeeklyChangeSet rejects duplicate event IDs, period mismatch, and same-period company conflicts; tests/weekly_radar_rising_dropped.rs verifies deterministic errors.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Resolve problems discovered within this Work Item in the current Work Item and record the fix in Summary, checkpoints, and Outcome; do not open a new WI for an in-scope correction.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The user-authorized companion test, scenario evidence correction, and this guideline-compliance correction were recorded in the active Contract/Summary and retried through the current WI's AI Cockpit checkpoints and Outcome.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not introduce rendering, persistence, delivery, scheduler, retry, trading, price prediction, target price, portfolio allocation, or capital-action behavior.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The standalone domain source and focused tests contain no rendering, persistence, delivery, scheduling, retry, trading, prediction, portfolio, or capital-action code; the Contract outOfScope and reference-impact evidence preserve this boundary.

risk.detail: Identity conflicts and evidence overlap are validated explicitly; stage/ranking semantics remain upstream and downstream boundaries remain untouched.

observedIssues.issue: Initial ai-start skeleton was not_ready because task evidence was empty.
observedIssues.resolution: Filled the same active Contract/Summary in this WI before coding; no successor WI created.

observedIssues.issue: Focused path-import tests emitted unused-public-accessor warnings.
observedIssues.resolution: Used the accessors in the focused test helpers; the next focused test run was warning-free.

observedIssues.issue: Clippy rejected the explicit PriceOnly/RankOnly/ScoreOnly labels for a shared enum postfix.
observedIssues.resolution: Kept the stable labels and added a local documented allow because the suffix is part of the no-event contract.

observedIssues.issue: AI Coverage guard has no configured association matching the required test path tests/weekly_radar_rising_dropped.rs for production stem rising_dropped.
observedIssues.resolution: User authorized an in-scope same-stem companion test; added tests/rising_dropped_test.rs without modifying the shared coverage policy.

residualRisks.detail: The standalone source is intentionally not registered in shared mod.rs; a later composition WI must explicitly wire it without changing WR-006 semantics.
Stage and structural delta labels are opaque supplied facts; this WI does not validate transformation meaning.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.

userCorrectionsCaptured.correction: If a problem is found, solve it in the current WI whenever it is in scope; do not casually create another WI.
